Corporate Director / Portfolio Holder Briefing - Regeneration.

Mark Lynam, Corporate Director, Regeneration, Environment and Economic Growth will be in attendance for this item. Councillor K Anderson, Portfolio Holder for Highways, Transport and Planning; Councillor M Pinder, Portfolio Holder for District Regeneration and Regional Growth; and Councillor A Wakefield, Portfolio Holder for Strategic Housing, Skills and Business Growth have been invited to attend for this item..

Helen Brailsford, Head of Service, Communities; and Councillor R Webster, Portfolio Holder for for Safer, Stronger Communities will be in attendance for this item.
